produces.meaning: one run of the pipeline has a provenance record: trace.json, prov.json and spur-report.html

evidence.why: spur_trace.py writes analysis/spur/<runId>/ with a run id it mints itself (a UTC timestamp unless --run-id is given), so no fixed path exists for a beat to require. A trace records a run; it is not a step another plugin must wait for.
